description: This file defines the FastRouteDispatcher class, which extends GroupCountBased and handles routing dispatch logic for the Slim Framework, including route matching and allowed methods retrieval.

classes.name: FastRouteDispatcher
classes.description: A dispatcher class for routing that extends GroupCountBased, handling route dispatching and allowed methods logic.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a request based on HTTP method and URI, returning routing results or fallback responses.

methods.name: routingResults
methods.description: Determines routing result for a given HTTP method and URI, checking static and variable routes.

methods.name: getAllowedMethods
methods.description: Returns a list of allowed HTTP methods for a specific URI.
